title: Spotify login outage, Nov 24 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Spotify, any news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Spotify users in at least a dozen countries reported login problems, with more than 16,500 Downdetector reports in the US alone. Spotify has not said how many people were affected.
who_is_affected: Spotify users on the morning of Nov 24 (US time) who were logged out and could not sign back in. Sign-ins were working again for many by about 7:15 AM ET. Users still having trouble can contact Spotify support.

known.text: On the morning of Nov 24, many Spotify users were logged out and could not sign back in.
Spotify's status account said it was aware of issues and checking them out. It gave no cause.

not_known.text: What caused the outage. Spotify has not said.
Whether it was a cyberattack. No one has claimed one, reported one, or ruled one out.
When the problem was fully fixed. Spotify has not given an end time.
